messages:
Ravi: Alerting  — customers reporting intermittent 503s from the hosted inference /v1/generate endpoint in eu-west-2. Spike started ~08:04 UTC. Posting status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2795000000 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2795000000 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/generate-503s. Pager notified to oncall.
Jules (oncall): Acknowledged. Pulling traces and error samples now. Initial glance shows increased connection resets to model-serving pool behind proxy-eu-west-2.
Tess: Infra: temporarily throttling burst ingress at edge and adding one replica to model-serving pool. Also toggled keepalive tuning per runbook.
Jules (oncall): Applied throttles and spun up +1 replica. Early signal: 503s dropped from ~9% -> 2.2% in 4m. Still seeing sporadic resets from srv-12.
Nina (product): Notifying CS and adding customer blurb: "We're investigating intermittent 503 errors in eu-west-2 for the generation API; mitigations in flight." Approve to publish?
Ravi: Approved. Add note that lower-volume calls unaffected and we're prioritizing impacted customers.
Jules (oncall): Next steps: cordon srv-12 if resets continue, collect core dumps if crash loop, and open partner ticket for upstream proxy if needed.
Ops-Bot: Update INC-2795000000: mitigations applied, monitoring. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2795000000
Tess: Metrics: 503 rate steady ~1.8% over last 6m; P95 latency slightly elevated (~120ms). Keeping scaling and throttle for 30m, will report status.
Ravi: Posting interim status on status page and emailing affected tenants. Will close thread when stable for 1h.
